result:
Post revisions are implemented and verified. `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, and `bun test` all pass (10 tests, including 8 new ones), and the framework's own `guren check` and `guren audit` report no failures.

**What was built**

- **Storage.** A `post_revisions` table with `id`, `post_id`, `title`, `excerpt`, `body`, `created_at` (ISO 8601 text), a foreign key to `posts` with cascade delete, and an index on `post_id`. The migration was generated with the project's `db:make` script and applied to the dev database.
- **Keeping versions.** Saving the edit form now runs in one transaction that first stores the post's current title, excerpt and body as a revision, then applies the update. Validation and authorization happen before that, so a refused edit keeps nothing. Creating a post keeps nothing.
- **History page.** `GET /posts/:id/revisions` renders `posts/Revisions` with `post` and `revisions: [{ id, title, createdAt }]`, newest first. The post page shows a Revisions link to the author next to Edit.
- **Restore.** `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` puts that revision's fields back on the post through the same keep-then-update path, so the replaced version becomes a new revision and the restored one stays. It redirects to `/posts/:id`. A revision belonging to another post answers 404 and changes nothing.
- **Authorization.** Two new abilities on the post policy, both author-only. Non-authors get 403, guests are redirected to `/login` by the existing `auth` middleware alias.
- **Delete.** Destroying a post deletes its revisions explicitly inside a transaction, on top of the cascade, since SQLite only honours cascades when foreign keys are enabled.

**Files**

- `db/schema.ts`, `db/migrations/20260925040421_add_post_revisions/`
- `app/Models/PostRevision.ts` (new), `app/Models/Post.ts`
- `app/Http/Controllers/PostRevisionController.ts` (new), `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`
- `app/Http/Resources/PostRevisionResource.ts` (new), `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`, `app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts`
- `routes/web.ts`, `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx` (new), `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`
- `tests/PostRevisions.test.ts` (new), plus regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts`

One note for whoever writes further tests: mutating requests in this app pass through CSRF, so the test client must be primed with `withCsrf()` before `actingAs()` requests, as the new test file does.

Summary: I added a `post_revisions` table and migration, a `PostRevision` model with a `keep()` helper, and two transactional helpers on `Post` (`updateKeepingRevision`, `deleteWithRevisions`) that the existing update and destroy actions now call. A new `PostRevisionController` serves the history page and the restore action at `/posts/:id/revisions` and `/posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore`, guarded by new author-only `viewRevisions` and `restore` policy abilities, with a `Revisions.tsx` page and a link from the post page. Route and page helpers were regenerated with `guren codegen`, and `tests/PostRevisions.test.ts` covers keeping, listing order, restore, wrong-post 404, 403 for other users, guest redirects, and delete cleanup.
